data.description: The Wave Slide is a single red lane that rises and dips as it comes down from a 5 ft steel ladder. The waves slow the child slightly at each bump and then speed them up again, which makes a short slide feel livelier. It is a single-lane version of our Double Wave Slide, so it fits a smaller space or a lower budget. Schools often use a wave slide alongside a swing or climber to give children a quick ride between other activities. The colour is Play Red. Our standard warranty covers galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts for 3 years. Ask us for a quote and a layout drawing for your play area.

items.pText: The Wave Slide is a single red lane that rises and dips as it comes down from a 5 ft steel ladder. The waves slow the child slightly at each bump and then speed them up again, which makes a short slide feel livelier. It is a single-lane version of our Double Wave Slide, so it fits a smaller space or a lower budget. Schools often use a wave slide alongside a swing or climber to give children a quick ride between other activities. The colour is Play Red. Our standard warranty covers galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts for 3 years. Ask us for a quote and a layout drawing for your play area.

The wave-profile bed is moulded and the ladder is galvanised steel. Our team fixes it self-standing or by grouting. Keep a soft surface at the foot of the slide, and check the slide bed for cracks and the ladder for loose fittings during regular maintenance.
